summary: Tested new message deletion functionality: 1) Admin soft-delete for conversation threads, 2) Swipe-to-delete gesture on conversation list items, 3) Delete confirmation dialog, 4) Individual message deletion for admin/employee/consignor own messages, 5) Deleted messages/conversations filtered from responses
context_for_next_testing_agent: Message deletion feature fully tested. Backend tests cover: admin conversation list/detail retrieval, admin reply sending, admin message deletion (own messages only), employee message deletion (own messages only), consignor message deletion (own messages only), unread count filtering. Frontend tests cover: conversations section visibility, swipe hint visibility, delete button in DOM, delete confirmation dialog, admin send/delete message flow, message input styling (6 rows, 150px min-height), participant type badges, filter buttons functionality.

admin_thread_soft_delete.details: DELETE /api/conversations/admin/conversation/{id} soft-deletes thread with deleted_at, deleted_by fields

admin_message_deletion.details: DELETE /api/conversations/admin/message/{conversation_id}/{message_id} deletes admin's own messages only

employee_message_deletion.details: DELETE /api/conversations/employee/message/{message_id} deletes employee's own messages only

consignor_message_deletion.details: DELETE /api/conversations/consignor/message/{message_id}?email={email} deletes consignor's own messages only

swipe_to_delete_gesture.details: Swipe hint visible on conversation items, delete button revealed on swipe

delete_confirmation_dialog.details: Confirmation dialog appears with cancel/confirm buttons when deleting thread

deleted_messages_filtered.details: Deleted messages are filtered out from conversation responses

deleted_conversations_filtered.details: Soft-deleted conversations are filtered out from conversation list
